title: A penalised Saito functional for heuristic search of free line arrangements
abstract: arXiv:2604.02995v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce the penalised Saito functional $\mathfrak S_{\lambda,\beta}(\mathcal{A};d_1,d_2)$ for a reduced arrangement $\mathcal{A}$ of $n$ lines and a prescribed pair $d_1+d_2=n-1$. It measures the alignment of a candidate Saito determinant with the defining polynomial while penalising the failure of the candidate derivations to be logarithmic. We prove that the functional takes values in $[0,1]$, vanishes exactly when $\mathcal{A}$ is free with exponents $(1,d_1,d_2)$, and lies strictly between $0$ and $1$ otherwise. For fixed $(d_1,d_2)$, it is upper semicontinuous on the reduced configuration space, continuous at arrangements free with the prescribed pair, and converges as $\lambda\to\infty$ to the corresponding binary freeness test.   We use a numerical approximation of this functional, together with a small $b_2$-shell term, to guide fixed-cardinality line-replacement searches over $\mathbb{Q}$ and selected quadratic ex

translated_title: 用于自由直线构形启发式搜索的带惩罚Saito泛函
translated_abstract: 我们为 $n$ 条直线的约化构形 $\mathcal{A}$ 以及给定的数对 $d_1+d_2=n-1$ 引入了带惩罚的 Saito 泛函 $\mathfrak S_{\lambda,\beta}(\mathcal{A};d_1,d_2)$。该泛函衡量候选 Saito 行列式与定义多项式的对齐程度，同时对候选导子不满足对数性条件的情况施加惩罚。我们证明该泛函取值于 $[0,1]$ 区间，当且仅当 $\mathcal{A}$ 是以 $(1,d_1,d_2)$ 为指数的自由构形时恰好为零，否则严格介于 $0$ 与 $1$ 之间。对于固定的 $(d_1,d_2)$，该泛函在约化构形空间上是上半连续的，在具有指定数对的自由构形处连续，且当 $\lambda\to\infty$ 时收敛于相应的二元自由性判别法。我们利用该泛函的数值近似，结合一个小的 $b_2$-壳层项，来指导在 $\mathbb{Q}$ 上及选定的二次扩张上进行的固定基数直线替换搜索……
tldr: 本文提出一种取值于[0,1]的带惩罚Saito泛函，它当且仅当直线构形以指定指数自由时为零，并可通过数值近似启发式地搜索自由直线构形。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a penalised Saito functional taking values in [0,1] that vanishes exactly when a line arrangement is free with prescribed exponents, enabling numerical heuristic searches for free line arrangements.
